style: Create one photorealistic architectural interior visualization, landscape 16:9, target 1920x1080. Cohesive apartment series: restrained contemporary classical interior, fine narrow wall mouldings, small 60mm cornice suitable for a real 2.70m ceiling, matte surfaces, pale natural oak herringbone, ivory linen, satin aged brass, honed warm limestone. Palette: creamy off-white #F1EDE4, warm khaki #B5A58C, smoky muted jade #596D69, with sparse espresso-brown #514642. Soft diffuse daylight and discreet warm 3000K practical lighting, neutral-warm editorial colour grade, realistic compact domestic scale, eye-level architectural camera with straight verticals and moderate wide angle, carefully composed environmental frame. No people, no writing, no labels, no logos, no watermark. Avoid palace proportions, excessive gilding, baroque ornament, giant rooms, fisheye lens and invented windows. All images belong to the same modest apartment.
reference: Reference image is the supplied measured apartment plan, geometry reference only. Top is north in the drawing. Keep partitions, room adjacency, window and door positions; do not redesign the apartment shell. Clear ceiling height is 2.70m. Room 1 upper-left is proposed bedroom 4.63m east-west x2.97m north-south, with windows on north AND west and entry near southeast. Room 2 lower part is proposed compact kitchen-living room, 5.04m widest east-west x2.97m north-south, L-shaped with an upper-right notch occupied by hall, a west-side balcony door/window, and entry from hall on north-east notch. Room3 is small L-shaped internal hallway to right, room4 is 2.39x1.93m windowless bathroom above it. Room5 is 1.12x2.53m narrow west-side loggia off room2. scenes.title: Спальня
scenes.prompt: ROOM 1 BEDROOM. View from northeast side toward south bed wall and west window. A 160x200cm ivory upholstered bed with a simple low gently curved headboard is centered on the solid SOUTH wall; fine symmetrical khaki wall mouldings behind the headboard, small 30cm walnut bedside tables and small brass wall sconces. West wall has the existing window with full length light ivory curtains; retain another north window outside or at edge of camera, do not turn this into a door or a panoramic glass wall. A 60cm-deep floor-to-ceiling warm khaki wardrobe is on the upper EAST wall, leaving the southeast entry accessible; it can be out of frame. Foot of bed has about 0.95m clearance, no bench blocking the aisle. Restrained jade throw, off-white bedding, small espresso cushion. Real compact 13.7-square-metre bedroom proportions. Show bed, wall mouldings and actual corner-window daylight.

scenes.title: Кухня-гостиная
scenes.prompt: ROOM 2 KITCHEN-LIVING MAIN VIEW. View from southwest near the balcony door toward the east kitchen and north wall. This is a SMALL L-shaped 14-square-metre room, not an open grand living room. Main blank SOUTH wall carries a straight 2.70m kitchen toward its eastern end: slim shaker smoky jade base and upper cabinetry, integrated appliances, pale limestone worktop and backsplash, satin brass handles. Tall integrated fridge at east end stops before the service riser in the extreme southeast corner. NO island. Kitchen is along the south wall, not beneath an invented window. On the solid upper-left NORTH wall sits a compact 180cm ivory sofa with one jade and one cocoa cushion; behind it thin khaki mouldings. A small 75cm round walnut dining table and TWO compact upholstered chairs occupy the western living zone without blocking the west balcony door. East-northeast wall steps inward by around a metre for hallway, with the existing entry in that recessed hall boundary; make this notch readable, not a plain rectangle. The only glazing is on the WEST wall to loggia behind camera, no new windows on east or south. Pale oak herringbone, small opal-and-brass close-to-ceiling light, no oversized chandelier. Tight realistic circulation.

scenes.title: Прихожая
scenes.prompt: ROOM 3 HALLWAY. Eye-level view from the east entrance door looking WEST into the small L-shaped internal hall. Overall depth 2.00m, upper width2.39m, lower width1.75m, noticeable 0.64m leftward shoulder leading to bedroom. Bathroom doorway on NORTH wall toward right of view, bedroom opening to WEST at upper end of the L, kitchen-living doorway on SOUTH. Keep all three passages clear. A shallow 26cm deep khaki shoe cabinet fitted into an available short wall, a tall rectangular mirror in a thin aged-brass frame above it, one petite cocoa upholstered pouf tucked under open shelf. Warm ivory walls with very thin rectangular mouldings, solid doors painted khaki with satin brass handles, warm limestone floor in medium tiles. Small opal ceiling light, realistic windowless ambient illumination with daylight borrowed through bedroom. No exterior windows, no arches, no invented long corridor, no wide hallway.

scenes.title: Санузел
scenes.prompt: ROOM4 BATHROOM, compact rectangular 2.39m east-west x1.93m north-south, 2.70m ceiling, NO WINDOWS. View from south doorway toward NORTH wall. Preserve the plan's basin near the center of NORTH wall and toilet to its right near northeast; preserve utility shaft in southeast corner, no relocation of doorway. Add a compact 80x110cm shower on WEST side with a single clear glass screen, fitting into this small bathroom. North-wall 55cm wide muted jade vanity with pale stone top and inset sink, above it a rectangular brass-framed mirror with softly rounded corners. Wall-hung toilet immediately east of vanity against north wall, its shallow concealed-cistern wall clad in pale limestone. Walls honed ivory limestone, subtle jade ceramic accents in shower, slim brass taps, small warm sconces near mirror. Restrained modern classic detailing in cabinetry rather than elaborate wall mouldings in shower. No bathtub, no double vanity, no additional washbasin, no invented window. Room should visibly feel 4.6 square metres, not a spa suite.

A tiny round brass wall light and fine restrained moulding on far ivory wall; slim walnut ledge on solid east wall, one small potted olive-like plant, light limestone tile floor.
